description: The default unit test runner since Angular 21, run by `ng test` through the `@angular/build:unit-test` builder.
Angular's testing utility that configures a test module (`imports`, `providers`) and creates components and services.
Resolves once Angular has run change detection and finished pending work. The main way to sync DOM in zoneless tests.
Introducing deliberate bugs (mutants) to check that the test suite detects them.
Experimental schematic (`ng g @schematics/angular:refactor-jasmine-vitest`) that rewrites Jasmine specs to Vitest.
